info.name: Aevo Exchange Private REST Account Orders API

description.content:
Authenticated REST API for Aevo exchange providing account management, order placement and management, position tracking, portfolio data, transfers, withdrawals, and trading history. Requires AEVO-KEY and AEVO-SECRET authentication headers obtained via cryptographic key registration.
